settings.heading: WHAT SETS OUR PLATES APART
How fast is delivery?
settings.row_content:
Orders placed before 12pm (Monday–Friday) are dispatched the same day via Royal Mail Tracked 48 or another 48-hour tracked courier.

Please allow up to 3 working days for delivery before contacting us.

Please note, orders are not shipped on weekends.

settings.heading: Are your plates road legal?
settings.row_content: Show plates are number plates made using legal components but intended for off-road or novelty use only. Tinted, coloured, and Krystal/Neon plates all fall under this category and are not road legal for use on UK roads, despite often being seen on vehicles. The only road-legal character colour permitted is black. All tinted, coloured, and Krystal/Neon plates supplied by Elite Plates are sold strictly as show plates for off-road use only.

settings.heading: When placing your order, you can choose between Road Legal Plates or Show Plates.
settings.row_content:
Road legal plates are manufactured in line with UK regulations, including correct character spacing and required supplier markings to meet British Standards.
Show plates are supplied as entered, with custom spacing, options of tinted acrylics, krystal digits and no legal markings, and are intended for display purposes only.

settings.heading: What is your cancellation policy?
settings.row_content: If you wish to cancel your order, please contact us as soon as possible via our social media platforms rather than email for the fastest response. Orders placed before 12pm are usually dispatched the same working day, so cancellation requests must be made quickly and preferably via our social media platforms rather than email. Once an order has been processed or fulfilled, we are unable to offer refunds as all products are custom-made to order, unless an error has been made on our part.
